meta.scope: Terrain Generation Phase 1: hex map rendering, river overlay, coastline, lake generation, terrain display, fog of war

findings.title: River overlay color exceeds STYLE.md water brightness range
findings.description: RiverOverlay.tsx uses RIVER_COLOR = '#4a90d9' which computes to ~51% lightness. STYLE.md specifies water elements should be in the #1a2535-#2a3a50 range (15-24% lightness). The river strokes are over twice as bright as allowed.
findings.evidence: RIVER_COLOR = '#4a90d9' → HSL(213, 60%, 51%). STYLE.md water range: #1a2535 (17%L) to #2a3a50 (24%L).
findings.suggestedFix: Change RIVER_COLOR to oklch(0.22, 0.04, 240) or similar value within the 15-24% lightness range.

findings.title: Fog of war unexplored color has purple tint instead of neutral black
findings.description: HexTile.tsx uses UNEXPLORED_HEX_COLOR = '#1e1b2e' for unexplored hexes. STYLE.md requires unexplored = black. The color has a noticeable purple/blue tint (hue 250°) instead of being a neutral dark. While low brightness (13%), the chromatic component contradicts the spec.
findings.evidence: UNEXPLORED_HEX_COLOR = '#1e1b2e' → HSL(250, 25%, 14%). Should be near-neutral: hsl(0, 0%, 5-10%).
findings.suggestedFix: Change to '#0a0a0a' or oklch(0.08, 0, 0) for a true neutral black.

findings.title: HexBreadcrumb TERRAIN_COLORS: 10 of 22 entries exceed 40% brightness ceiling
findings.description: HexBreadcrumb.tsx defines a TERRAIN_COLORS map with 22 terrain types. 10 entries have lightness above the STYLE.md 40% ceiling for world surfaces: savanna (55%L), grassland (42%L), temperate_forest (45%L), tropical_forest (41%L), boreal_forest (42%L), coastal_shallows (55%L), reef (53%L), river (56%L), lake (57%L), desert (60%L).
findings.evidence: Computed HSL values for all 22 entries. 10 exceed 40%L ceiling. Worst offenders: desert (60%L), lake (57%L), river (56%L).
findings.suggestedFix: Remap all entries to stay within 10-40% lightness. Use STYLE.md sphere color palette as reference for hue selection.

findings.title: Coastline test asserts stale coastEdge value
findings.description: terrain.test.ts may assert an outdated coastEdge count or structure after the coast→coastal_shallows rename and new terrain types were added. Test assertions should be reviewed against current terrain generation output.
findings.evidence: terrain.test.ts coastline assertions may reference old terrain names or counts.
findings.suggestedFix: Run npm test, check for failures in terrain.test.ts, update assertions to match current terrain generation output.

findings.title: All hex tile and overlay images fail to load with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED
findings.description: Every hex tile terrain image and location overlay image fails to load with net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. This affects all image elements in the visible hex cluster. The fallback biome-color polygon renders correctly so hexes are not invisible, but the intended hand-painted terrain art is entirely absent. The image files exist on disk at public/hex-tiles/ (54+ files). The failure appears related to Vite HMR connection issues — the console shows 'server connection lost' alongside the HMR export error (IX-203). This may be a transient dev-server issue.
findings.evidence: Console errors: 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED' for /hex-tiles/hills.png, /hex-tiles/plateau.png, etc. Files confirmed present at public/hex-tiles/.
findings.suggestedFix: Investigate whether this is a Vite static asset serving regression or port conflict. Verify files accessible at /hex-tiles/ after a fresh dev server restart.

findings.title: Hex hover tooltip missing elevation, temperature, and moisture data
findings.description: When hovering a visible hex tile, the tooltip shows only terrain type and flavor text. S-005 spec requires elevation, temperature, and moisture. The data exists in tile.geoParams but is never passed to the Tooltip component.
findings.evidence: HexTile.tsx line 189-193: only terrain name passed to Tooltip, no geoParams.
findings.suggestedFix: Extend Tooltip to accept additional key-value data props and pass tile.geoParams from HexTile.

findings.title: Vite HMR error: hexPolygonPoints export not found in HexTile.tsx
findings.description: Console shows HMR error: 'The requested module HexTile.tsx does not provide an export named hexPolygonPoints'. The function is in hexMath.ts, not HexTile.tsx. HMR module graph is stale. App works on initial load but hot-reload is broken for hex map files.
findings.evidence: Console: '[vite] SyntaxError: The requested module /src/components/HexMap/HexTile.tsx does not provide an export named hexPolygonPoints'
findings.suggestedFix: Clear Vite module cache (rm -rf node_modules/.vite) and restart dev server. Check for incorrect import sites with grep.

findings.title: Move mode has no visual indicator on hex map
findings.description: When Move button is clicked, hex map provides no visual feedback for valid move targets. No hex highlighting, cursor change, or persistent instruction. The 10-second auto-timeout cancels move mode silently.
findings.evidence: useViewNavigation.ts lines 116-130: no visual highlighting logic for moveMode targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add visual highlighting to valid move target hexes when moveMode is active. Show persistent instruction overlay.

findings.title: Hex tile SVG elements lack data attributes for terrain type and coordinates
findings.description: Hex tile SVG <g> elements carry no data-terrain, data-col, data-row attributes. Cannot identify specific hexes in automated tests or screen readers.
findings.evidence: HexTile.tsx renders no data-* attributes on any SVG element.
findings.suggestedFix: Add data-terrain={tile.terrain} data-col={tile.coord.col} data-row={tile.coord.row} to outer <g> element.

findings.title: HexZoomView for out-of-sight hex leaks terrain name and faction
findings.description: When clicking a non-visible hex, HexZoomView shows 'No Sight' but the breadcrumb reveals terrain type name ('Plateau') and faction affiliations. This undermines fog of war.
findings.evidence: Snapshot: heading 'Plateau (8, 6)' with faction names shown despite 'No Sight' status.
findings.suggestedFix: When sight level is 'No Sight', replace terrain name with 'Unknown' and hide faction affiliations.

findings.title: Inline arrow closures create 960 new function refs per render in HexMap
findings.description: HexMap.tsx lines 185-187 pass inline arrow functions as onClick/onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave to every HexTileComponent. With ~320 tiles, this creates ~960 new function references per render, defeating React.memo on children.
findings.evidence: onClick={() => handleHexClick(tile)}, onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredHex(tile)}, onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredHex(null)}
findings.suggestedFix: Use useCallback with tile ID lookup, or pass tile.id as data attribute and read from event.currentTarget.dataset in a single stable handler.

findings.title: HexTileComponent not memoized — 320 tiles re-render on every hover
findings.description: HexTile.tsx exports HexTileComponent as a plain function component without React.memo. Since HexMap re-renders on every hover (hoveredHex state change), all 320 tiles re-render even though only 1-2 changed.
findings.evidence: HexTile.tsx:64: export function HexTileComponent — no React.memo wrapper.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap with React.memo and define a custom comparison function that checks tile.coord, tile.terrain, and visibility state.

findings.title: HexDefs not memoized despite constant SVG output
findings.description: HexDefs.tsx renders static SVG <defs> (clip paths, patterns) that never change. Not wrapped in React.memo, so it re-renders whenever HexMap re-renders.
findings.evidence: HexDefs.tsx:7: export function HexDefs — returns constant SVG defs block.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap with React.memo(() => ...) — no comparison needed since output is static.

findings.title: CoastlineOverlay not memoized — recalculates coastlines on every hover
findings.description: CoastlineOverlay.tsx is a plain function component that recomputes coastline edge detection on every parent re-render. Since HexMap re-renders on hover, coastlines are recalculated on every mouse move.
findings.evidence: CoastlineOverlay component: no React.memo, runs edge detection logic on every render.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap with React.memo. Coastline data only changes when tiles change, not on hover.

findings.title: RiverOverlay not memoized — recalculates river paths on every hover
findings.description: RiverOverlay.tsx is a plain function component. River path computation (bezier curve generation from river data) reruns on every HexMap render triggered by hover state changes.
findings.evidence: RiverOverlay component: no React.memo wrapper.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap with React.memo. River paths only change when river data changes.

findings.title: Magic numbers in HexTile for selection ring geometry
findings.description: HexTile.tsx line 102 uses inline magic numbers for the selection ring (stroke width, offset values) instead of named constants. Violates project priority #1: tunability.
findings.evidence: Hardcoded numeric values in selection ring rendering logic.
findings.suggestedFix: Extract to named constants: SELECTION_RING_STROKE_WIDTH, SELECTION_RING_OFFSET, etc.

findings.title: ~25 hardcoded biome thresholds in terrain.ts without named constants
findings.description: terrain.ts lines 13-101 contain ~25 hardcoded numeric thresholds for biome classification (elevation, temperature, moisture cutoffs). These are the primary tunables for terrain generation but are buried as inline numbers in if/else chains.
findings.evidence: terrain.ts: elevation < 0.15, moisture > 0.65, temperature < 0.3, etc. — all inline in classification function.
findings.suggestedFix: Extract all thresholds to a TERRAIN_THRESHOLDS config object exported from terrain.ts or a separate config file.

findings.title: hexToPixel duplicates HEX_SCALE constants with inline values
findings.description: hexMath.ts line 59-60: hexToPixel uses inline numeric values for hex scaling that duplicate the HEX_SCALE_X/Y constants defined elsewhere. Changing one won't update the other.
findings.evidence: hexMath.ts:59-60: inline scale values instead of referencing HEX_SCALE constants.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace inline values with HEX_SCALE_X and HEX_SCALE_Y constant references.

findings.title: Fog opacity values hardcoded in HexMap
findings.description: HexMap.tsx line 214 uses hardcoded fog opacity values instead of named constants. These control the visual appearance of fog of war layers.
findings.evidence: Inline opacity values in fog rendering logic.
findings.suggestedFix: Extract to FOG_OPACITY_UNEXPLORED, FOG_OPACITY_REMEMBERED constants.

findings.title: Fog recover layer recomputes on every hover
findings.description: HexMap.tsx lines 201-219: The fog/recover layer iterates all tiles to compute visibility classes on every render. Since hovering triggers re-render, this O(n) computation runs on every mouse move.
findings.evidence: Fog layer computation inside render body, not memoized.
findings.suggestedFix: Memoize fog layer computation with useMemo, keyed on visibleHexes and tile data (not hoveredHex).

findings.title: HexFlavorPanel missing flavor texts for ~15 terrain types
findings.description: HexFlavorPanel.tsx lines 7-33 define flavor text for only ~7 terrain types. The engine now generates 18+ types, leaving many with no flavor text and likely hitting a fallback or empty display.
findings.evidence: HexFlavorPanel.tsx: limited terrain type coverage in flavor text map.
findings.suggestedFix: Add flavor text entries for all 18 terrain types from the terrain engine.

findings.title: HexBreadcrumb missing color entries for ~20 terrain types
findings.description: HexBreadcrumb.tsx TERRAIN_COLORS map has 22 entries but the engine defines additional terrain types that may not be covered. New terrain types from Phase 1 need color entries.
findings.evidence: TERRAIN_COLORS map coverage vs engine terrain type list.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit terrain types from terrain.ts and ensure every type has a TERRAIN_COLORS entry within STYLE.md brightness range.

findings.title: forceField.ts has 12 private noise constants that should be tunable
findings.description: forceField.ts lines 13-26 define 12 private constants controlling terrain noise generation (octaves, persistence, lacunarity, scale factors). These are critical terrain tunables but are not exported or configurable.
findings.evidence: 12 private const declarations in forceField.ts controlling terrain generation parameters.
findings.suggestedFix: Export constants in a FORCE_FIELD_CONFIG object. Consider making them overridable via world generation settings.

findings.title: worldGenData.ts throws on missing geo params instead of failing soft
findings.description: worldGenData.ts lines 62-63 throw an error when geo parameters are missing instead of providing a fallback. Violates project priority #4: fail-soft.
findings.evidence: throw new Error on missing geoParams in worldGenData.ts.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a default geoParams object instead of throwing. Log a warning for debugging.

findings.title: Duplicate mulberry32 PRNG implementation across forceField.ts and riverGeneration.ts
findings.description: Both forceField.ts:4 and riverGeneration.ts:11 implement the same mulberry32 PRNG function. This should be a shared utility.
findings.evidence: Identical mulberry32 function in two files.
findings.suggestedFix: Extract mulberry32 to src/lib/prng.ts and import from both files.

findings.title: Triple tile array iteration per render in HexMap
findings.description: HexMap.tsx iterates the full tile array 3 times per render: once for tile rendering (~line 167), once for fog layer (~line 201), once for overlay layer (~line 222). With 320+ tiles, this is ~960 iterations per render.
findings.evidence: Three separate .map() calls over tiles array in HexMap render body.
findings.suggestedFix: Combine into a single pass that produces all three SVG layer groups, or memoize each layer independently.

findings.title: Hex map click handlers on non-semantic SVG elements without keyboard support
findings.description: HexTile onClick handlers are on SVG <g> elements without role='button', tabIndex, or onKeyDown handlers. Hexes are not keyboard-accessible.
findings.evidence: HexTile.tsx: <g onClick={...}> with no keyboard event handlers or ARIA attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add role='button', tabIndex={0}, and onKeyDown handler (Enter/Space) to interactive hex elements.

findings.title: CoastlineOverlay SVG paths lack aria-hidden
findings.description: Coastline overlay renders decorative SVG paths without aria-hidden='true'. Screen readers may attempt to describe these paths.
findings.evidence: CoastlineOverlay.tsx: <path> elements without aria-hidden.
findings.suggestedFix: Add aria-hidden='true' to the coastline overlay <g> container.
